track: Track 2: The Agent That Can Explain Why
description: An autonomous multi-agent clinical supply chain resilience system that prevents catastrophic medicine stockouts through multi-source data auditing, deterministic zero-LLM-arithmetic calculations, and competing-hypothesis (Investigator vs Skeptic) debate loops with human escalation and persistent officer memory.

zetaris.role: Required data layer (Zetaris Lightning SQL, local docker stack)
zetaris.implementation: app/adapters/data_store.py reads every deterministic input with SQL from the Lightning database MEDTRACE_LH via POST /api/proxy/sql-editor/sqls/run-query (USE_ZETARIS=true). Each run emits a ZetarisDataLayer / DATA_SOURCE_SUMMARY trace event with queries_attempted, queries_ok and queries_fallback_to_csv.
zetaris.scope_note: One Lightning database over CSV FILESTORE tables; reference JSON files in data/real are read locally (no cross-engine federation).
zetaris.verified_query: SELECT * FROM MEDTRACE_LH.ledger_daily WHERE facility_id = 'FAC-WH-01' AND medicine_id = 'MED-006' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

engines_implemented.purpose: Headless shared canonical entity state across agents using content-derived stable IDs (ent_inv_*) and relational graph edges (HOLDS_INVENTORY, FOR_MEDICINE).
Hierarchical cross-session episodic memory tracking officer approvals, rejections, and penalties to dynamically tune action recommendations.
engines_implemented.tests: tests/test_world_model.py (H1, H2, H3) and tests/test_api.py (officer decision changes the next run)

meterless.runtime: Meterless Nightshift is the primary LLM provider (METERLESS_BASE_URL, model meterless/auto, headers meterless-app / meterless-scope) in app/adapters/llm_client.py; direct NVIDIA endpoint is the secondary route.

nvidia.role: Nemotron models served through Meterless Nightshift
nvidia.usage: Qualitative synthesis, Investigator vs Skeptic debate and memo text only; all arithmetic is deterministic. Model, llm_used and fallback are recorded per trace event.
nvidia.model: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b via Meterless Nightshift (primary route) or the NVIDIA API (secondary route) in app/adapters/llm_client.py

live_evidence.note: Produced with SAMPLE_MODE=false USE_ZETARIS=true; each trace has a DATA_SOURCE_SUMMARY event.

evaluation.benchmark_scope: Simulated data with 10 planted anomalies; held-out seeds share the generator. Rule-coverage check, not real-world accuracy.
